justification: Inspected `jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/BasicAttributeProvider.java` and `jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/AbstractAttributeView.java`. The nested `View` is a private adapter with one constructor and only 3 methods (`name`, `readAttributes`, `setTimes`); it just delegates file lookup to `AbstractAttributeView.lookupFile()` and does not accumulate separate responsibilities. The file’s broader attribute logic is split into the outer provider and the separate `Attributes` class, so there is no strong evidence of insufficient modularization in `View`.
